rows.quote: The GWAS data for PPD were sourced from the largest meta-analysis to date of the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium (PGC), comprising 18 cohorts of European ancestry, totalling 17,339 PPD cases and 53,426 controls.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names a consortium meta-analysis for a phenotype (17,339 cases, 53,426 controls) for which the dictionary has no row.
